Ver.2 comes with Amazonia Supplement pellets, which go underneath the soil
High CEC, so it takes up excess nutrients and waste from the water (shop claim)
1 bag for a 60×30×36 cm tank; 1.5 bags for 60×40×40 cm; 3 bags for a 90 cm tank; 5 bags per 1 m²

fits.fact: Made for planted tanks; ADA says beginners and experienced hobbyists can both use Ver.2
The black soil makes leaf colours stand out; in ADA's test, plants were denser and more deeply coloured than on Amazonia II after 2 months
One 9 L bag covers a standard 60 cm tank (60×30×36 cm); a 90 cm tank needs 2–3 bags
A retailer guide says standard Ver.2 suits plant-only tanks or dark starts. For sensitive Caridina shrimp it suggests Amazonia Light, which releases less ammonia
Not suited to cycling with fish already in the tank, because of the early ammonia spike
Shops recommend using it with ADA Power Sand underneath plus the matching base additives

usage.fact: Spread the Amazonia Supplement evenly over the tank bottom, then put the Ver.2 soil on top
You can add more or less Supplement to change how rich the substrate is, or put extra under particular areas of a large tank
Suggested layering: 15–25 mm of Power Sand, then 40–60 mm of soil, sloping from about 40 mm at the front to 80–100 mm at the back
New tank: change 30% of the water daily in week 1, 3 times in week 2 and twice in week 3, then weekly once stable
After 3 months to a year, you may need to change water more often again
Add livestock only after ammonia and nitrite have read zero for a while; test with liquid kits instead of following a fixed timeline
Lasts about 2–3 years. Nutrients are strongest in the first 8–12 months, so start liquid fertiliser around month 6 and replace the soil when growth slows

issues.fact: Releases ammonia when new. In ADA's own test, Ver.2 reached NH4 5.0 mg/L at 2 weeks, compared with 2.0 for Amazonia II, and both read zero by 1.5 months
A retailer guide reports an ammonia peak of about 4–8 ppm around days 3–7 that clears by days 14–21. Too much ammonia without water changes can make plants melt
Forum users say Ver.2 releases noticeably less ammonia than the original Amazonia
Old soil can break down over time; one user reported bubbles, a bad smell and decay in the lower layers and replaced the whole substrate
Version differences: Ver.2 uses the same base as Amazonia II and comes with a pellet supplement. The original Ver.1 (gold-lettered bag) is still sold in Vietnam at a higher price
Stock is patchy in Vietnam: several shops list it as out of stock or ask you to contact them for a price

alternatives.why: Cheaper, with no sharp ammonia spike reported, but its nutrients run out sooner, so root tabs are needed after about 10–12 months
Reported to release much less ammonia at the start, so shrimp or fish can go in sooner
Budget option, but the grains are softer and pack down faster, and pH buffering fades sooner, around month 9
